summary.ko: 작업 시작에 필요한 결정·자료·권한을 최소한의 질문과 체크리스트로 정리합니다.
summary.en: Gather the minimum project decisions, materials, and access needs required to begin work.

exclusions: Signing an agreement or granting account access

required_inputs.description: Service type, intended deliverables, and known client context
Information already supplied and remaining uncertainties

workflow.instruction: Compare the requested service with the information already available and avoid asking duplicate questions.
Group missing inputs into goals, audience, source assets, constraints, approvals, and delivery expectations.
Prioritize blockers and write answerable questions with examples or bounded choices where helpful.
Create a kickoff checklist with responsible party and completion evidence, using secure access routes rather than credential collection.

deliverables.name: Intake questionnaire
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Contains only relevant unanswered questions, with blocking items first

deliverables.name: Kickoff checklist
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Tracks inputs, decisions, responsible-party assumptions, and readiness

limitations: Do not request unnecessary personal data or credentials.
Do not infer client approval from form completion.
permission_boundaries: Do not send the questionnaire, create accounts, request persistent access, or upload client assets automatically.
Passwords, payment details, and secret tokens must never be collected in the intake form.
